title: Heard GPT-6 was good at 3D modeling, so I asked it to recreate BlackMyth: Wukong
author: OneTsing
selftext:
[Erlang, presented by GPT-6 with blender MCP](https://preview.redd.it/fr3qwop46xnh1.png?width=900&format=png&auto=webp&s=9bca6c950b21e8701933ce00d35d5518d23187ca)

I can’t stop laughing every time I look at Erlang’s face. Definitely worth the tokens 😂

I tried building a game with GPT-6, and after about 30 minutes, I ended up with something that is… barely playable, but somehow incredibly entertaining.

Here’s the game if anyone wants to try it:  
[https://dreamy-refuge-g22q.here.now/](https://dreamy-refuge-g22q.here.now/)

https://reddit.com/link/1w909d9/video/ik8fe6vg8xnh1/player

The result is obviously far from a real game anyone would invest time to play, but I actually think this is a pretty exciting starting point.

I still remember when a new model came out and one of my benchmarks was basically: **“Can it make Super Mario?”**

We’ve seen huge improvement since then, which was half a year ago. Now I can give an agent references, ask it to build a 3D game, and 30 minutes later I have something I can actually run around in—even if the characters look completely cursed.

Honestly, I’m more interested in the trajectory than the result itself.

Can’t imagine what this will look like six months from now.

Also, compared with my experiments using open-source models, the result here was noticeably better.

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
I don't think building a functional game in 1 prompt is what you want 

Because I have noticed with these quick set up ai games even Astra 

It gives 0 respect to the computers CPU and GPU 

Heck I wouldn't be surprised if it would even include many recursive functions and heavy math loading functions to run in process mode 

If it can't plan the bare basic standards of respecting peoples hardware it is far from ready 


These games can't scale impossible unless you run with the latest hardware or spend another month trying to optimize and organize the mess it creates in code

That's the problem Astra also still can't solve

comments.author: Secret-Coast-5564
comments.body:
Hahaha ok, Astra created the exact type of character for me the other day and I also thought it was hilarious. The same eyes etc!

I was having it iterate to achieve my reference image for a pirate game I'm working on. Currently sidetracked improving so many other things, but I'm getting back to the character soon.

I havent iterated on the character yet, so there's a bias in the training data for generating a character using python. But once I start that feedback loop for it to iterate, it should improve greatly. It has for my ship models etc, and I'm excited to see what it will do with my character models.
